articles.title: WW2 soldier's cigarette case returned to daughter he never met
articles.content: Moved to tears at the presentation at the Royal Welsh Regimental Museum in Brecon, Powys, Stan's daughter Diane Owen said: "I'm shocked. "I just wish I could have spoken to him. Thank you Filip, for bringing a little piece of his memory home.". Filip told Diane: "I've had many turbulent – I think you'd say in English - sleepless nights since...
articles.summary:
